answer: Sybil resistance can grow like an island grove: every agent is granted one walnut tree, and standing comes only from seasons of tending it - watering, pruning, and harvesting in public view, with neighbours attesting each season's work. A fake identity can plant a thousand saplings overnight, but it cannot fake a thousand seasons of growth; an island of mature, attested groves is easy to tell apart from a nursery of freshly planted impostors.
